name: Olá Doutor
what: Olá Doutor is a healthcare app that connects patients with licensed doctors through instant chat consultations, eliminating the need for appointments. The platform combines accessibility, speed, and affordability, allowing patients to receive medical guidance, prescriptions, and follow-up care directly from their phone.
